requirements.title: Elemental function references have scalar or greatest-rank result shape and elementwise values
requirements.definition: An elemental function reference has result shape matching the actual argument of greatest rank, or scalar result for no actual arguments or all scalar actual arguments; in the array case, result elements have the values obtained by applying the scalar function separately in array element order to corresponding array actual elements.

pending.elemental-function-scalar-result: PENDING positive plan: ELEMENTAL integer function affine(x,y)=10*x+y called with scalar x=3 and y=4 initializes result sentinel -1 and expects exact scalar 34.
pending.elemental-function-result-shape-greatest: PENDING positive plan: x(0:1,-1:1) has shape [2,3]; assert SHAPE(affine(x,7)) is exactly [2,3] before assigning to y(0:1,-1:1).
pending.elemental-function-array-scalar-mixing-v: PENDING positive plan: with x(0,-1)=1, x(1,-1)=2, x(0,0)=3, x(1,0)=4, x(0,1)=5, x(1,1)=6 and scalar y=7, assignment z=affine(x,7) changes z sentinels to exact values 17,27,37,47,57,67 at the corresponding non-unit-bound subscripts.
pending.elemental-function-conformable-array-val: PENDING positive plan: affine(a,b) with a=[1,2,3] and b=[10,20,30] returns exact [20,40,60], proving corresponding elements from both conformable arrays are used.
pending.elemental-function-empty-array-result: PENDING positive plan: call elemental inc on integer array x(1:0) and assert SIZE(inc(x)) == 0, with no element-value oracle claimed for absent elements.

requirements.oracle: The non-unit-bound plan is hand-computed: affine(x,7)=10*x+7, so x values 1..6 in column-major positions produce 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, and 67 at matching target subscripts. The shape oracle uses SHAPE, not lower bounds of an expression.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source registration creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Future fixture packets must keep diagnostic controls one-feature, use distinct sentinels before observation, and avoid processor-dependent addresses, file units, finalization order text, diagnostic wording, C symbol details, and coarray/image/team runtime observations.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6-11 for source form, declarations, expressions, execution constructs, arrays, pointers, allocation, and association; 15.3-15.6 for procedure characteristics, interfaces, argument association, and subprogram definition; 16 for intrinsic procedure classifications and ISO_C_BINDING procedures; 18 for C interoperability where C_LOC or C_FUNLOC is referenced; 19 for scope, host/use association, common, storage association, finalization, and variable definition contexts; 4.2 for required diagnostics.

accounting.rationale: Result shape, scalar-result, and elementwise value semantics are split into fine units.
Defines result shape from the actual argument of greatest rank.
Defines exact elementwise array result values in array element order.
The MAX example is informative; the normative p1 text owns the result-shape and elementwise semantics.

review_rationale: Source registration for 15.7 (pure procedures), 15.8 (simple procedures), 15.9 and 15.9.1-15.9.3 (elemental procedures) (batch237). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; C1592-C15121 had no existing tests and carry conforming one-feature diagnostic plans, only their coarray alternatives are out of scope, and elemental semantics are exact. Source accounting only.
